issues: Missing passive ability for "During your turn, whenever this takes ability damage, look at the top card of your deck. If it's an Omen card, you may reveal it and add it to your hand." Missing printed keyword Aura in keywords. Add "aura" to keywords to match the card text.

The protection is incomplete: grantIndestructible covers "can't be destroyed by abilities" but the card also can't be banished by abilities. Encode both protections; add engine support for an ability like grantCannotBeBanishedByAbilities or equivalent passive protection against banish effects.
